_meta.description: Canonical nav layout applied AFTER all manifest.d fragments merge (ADR-037/ADR-044, buildManifest.js). relocations: sourceId -> targetGroupId; a missing/synthetic target id (e.g. '__toplevel__') lifts the entry to the top level, and an emptied group shell is dropped. removals: leaf menu-entry ids retired from nav (their PAGES stay routable). settingsSection: top-level config/admin leaf ids lifted into the NC settings foldout (gear icon, outside the scrollable nav). nav-restructure-dashboards IA (amends ADR-009, supersedes ADR-044): the app opens on the top-level Dashboard; the Insight group is dissolved (Dashboard + Compliance promoted to top level); Learning + People are navigable domain dashboards whose leaves render as collapsible sub-children (so #removals no longer hides them); Features & roadmap sits in the footer beside Documentation; School-year rollover lives in the settings foldout. menu-six-main-items: DashboardAdmin/Teacher/Student are relocated UNDER the top-level Dashboard entry (declared in dashboard.json, route '/'), not removed. An earlier revision of this change did remove them, reasoning that 'their pages stay routable' — gate-53 removals-invariant rejected that, correctly: ADR-044 §5 requires each retired entry to stay REACHABLE, and routable is not reachable. Dashboard's route '/' renders only the user's DEFAULT role view (see the page's _note), so dropping all three menu entries would have stranded every other view for a multi-role user (an admin who also teaches could never open the teaching dashboard from the nav). Dashboard carries both a route and children, which CnAppNav supports — 'Route items are handled by :to and skip this path', so the title stays a real link to '/' and the chevron expands the three role views at depth 2. GroupProgress/GroupCompliance/GroupMyLearning are new top-level parents (declared with no route in progress.json/compliance.json/my-learning.json respectively) that every other group-with-children relocation target dissolves INTO — per buildManifest's documented relocation semantics a relocated group's own id/label is discarded and only its children merge into the target, so GroupTimetabling/GroupAdmissions/GroupPupilDossier/GroupConferences/GroupCompetency/GroupStudentAnalytics/GroupEngagement/GroupCourseEvaluation/GroupPortfolio/GroupStudyProgress/GroupBpv/GroupExamBoard all flatten one level rather than nesting three deep (menuItemLeaf has no children key in the v2 schema, and ADR-097 Decision 6 caps depth at two) — this is a deliberate deviation from the menu-six-main-items design.md's amended nav-card-grid mechanism, which would need new pages[] entries that this change's hard rules forbid; see the change's final report for the full reasoning. The pre-existing 'Compliance':'__toplevel__' relocation is now 'Compliance':'GroupCompliance' — its label was changed to 'Overview' at the source (dashboard.json) to avoid colliding with the new parent's own 'Compliance' label.

_settingsSectionNote: XapiStatementsMenu carries section:'settings' in the base manifest; Rollover (School-year rollover) is admin-gated structural config lifted here so the foldout is the single authoritative home for settings-adjacent leaves. FeaturesRoadmapMenu was removed by nav-restructure-dashboards (Phase A) — it renders in the footer beside Documentation. AssistantMenu was removed entirely by relocate-dataexchange-remove-assistant (Phase B) — the inherited AI chat is gone. DataExchange was also removed from the in-app foldout by Phase B: the data-exchange BACKEND + OSO are kept intact and its management UI now lives in the Nextcloud Admin Settings page (AdminRoot.vue → DataExchangeSettingsSection), which deep-links into the still-routable data-exchange pages.
